install.title: Install the app
install.body: Get in faster from your home screen, without going through the browser.
install.iosStep1: Tap the Share button in the Safari bar below.
install.iosStep2: Scroll down and choose "Add to Home Screen".
install.iosStep3: Tap "Add". That is it — you now have it as an app.
install.iosNote: On iPhone this only works from Safari. If you are in another browser, open this page in Safari first.

welcomeStaff.title: Welcome to TEMPPO!
welcomeStaff.body: A 30-second look at where everything lives. Skip it whenever you like.

schedule.title: Your schedule
schedule.body: Every class this week. Tap one to see who is coming, add students by hand, or mark attendance.

spots.title: Standing spots
spots.body: Who holds a place every week. See at a glance which times still have room — no spreadsheet needed.

checkin.title: Check-in
checkin.body: Scan a student QR code as they arrive and attendance is recorded instantly.

more.title: Everything else
more.body: In here: Students, Classes (where you build the repeating timetable), Leads, Packs, Payments, Reports and Settings. Logging out is in this menu too.

done.title: All set
done.body: Start with Classes to load your timetable. To see this tour again, it is in the More menu.

welcomeStudent.title: Hi there!
welcomeStudent.body: A quick look at how to book your classes.

myClasses.title: My classes
myClasses.body: Your upcoming classes and the QR code to get into the studio. Cancel from here too.

book.title: Book
book.body: Pick a day and time. If a class is full you join the waitlist, and we tell you the moment a spot opens.

buy.title: Buy
buy.body: Class packs. Pay online, or by transfer and send the receipt over WhatsApp.

account.title: Your account
account.body: Turn on notifications for class reminders and freed-up spots. Log out from here as well.

doneStudent.title: Off you go!
doneStudent.body: That is everything. Book your first class whenever you are ready.

panel.title: Your dashboard
panel.body: What is happening today: the next class with its spots, and anything needing you, like pending payments.

password.title: Choose your password
password.subtitle: Hi {name}, set a password to sign in from now on.
